q.en: Which is the phylogenetically oldest division of the cerebellum (archicerebellum / vestibulocerebellum), responsible for balance and the vestibulo-ocular reflex?
q.uz: Miyachaning muvozanat va vestibulo-okulyar refleks uchun javobgar bo'lgan filogenetik eng qadimgi bo'limi (arxiserebellum / vestibuloserebellum) qaysi?

options.en: Flocculonodular lobe (lobule X — flocculus and nodulus)
options.uz: Flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha — flokkulus va nodulus)

options.en: Anterior lobe (lobules I–V, rostral to the primary fissure)
options.uz: Oldingi bo'lak (I–V bo'lakchalar, birlamchi yoriqdan oldinda)

options.en: Lateral posterior lobe hemispheres (Crus I and Crus II)
options.uz: Orqa bo'lak lateral yarimsharlari (Crus I va Crus II)

options.en: Cerebellar tonsils (lobule IX on the inferior vermian aspect)
options.uz: Miyacha bodomchalari (pastki chuvalchang yonidagi IX bo'lakcha)

why.en: The flocculonodular lobe (lobule X, comprising the midline nodulus and paired lateral flocculi) is the oldest cerebellar division (archicerebellum / vestibulocerebellum). Separated from the corpus cerebelli by the posterolateral fissure, it receives direct primary and secondary vestibular afferents and regulates equilibrium and gaze stabilization.
why.uz: Flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha — o'rta chiziqdagi nodulus va juft lateral flokkuluslar) miyachaning eng qadimgi bo'limidir (arxiserebellum / vestibuloserebellum). Miyacha tanasidan orqa-lateral yoriq bilan ajralgan bo'lib, bevosita birlamchi va ikkilamchi vestibulyar tolalarni qabul qiladi hamda muvozanat va nigohni barqarorlashtirishni boshqaradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Which deep fissure on the superior surface of the cerebellum separates the anterior lobe (lobules I–V) from the posterior lobe (lobules VI–IX)?
q.uz: Miyachaning ustki yuzasidagi qaysi chuqur yoriq oldingi bo'lakni (I–V bo'lakchalar) orqa bo'lakdan (VI–IX bo'lakchalar) ajratib turadi?

options.en: Primary fissure (fissura prima)
options.uz: Birlamchi yoriq (fissura prima)

options.en: Posterolateral fissure (fissura posterolateralis)
options.uz: Orqa-lateral yoriq (fissura posterolateralis)

options.en: Horizontal fissure (between Crus I and Crus II)
options.uz: Gorizontal yoriq (Crus I va Crus II orasida)

options.en: Retrotonsillar fissure (dorsal to lobule IX)
options.uz: Retrotonsillyar yoriq (IX bo'lakcha orqasida)

why.en: The primary fissure (fissura prima) on the superior cerebellar surface divides the anterior lobe (lobules I–V, primarily spinocerebellar sensorimotor representation) from the much larger posterior lobe (lobules VI–IX, between the primary and posterolateral fissures).
why.uz: Miyacha ustki yuzasidagi birlamchi yoriq (fissura prima) oldingi bo'lakni (I–V bo'lakchalar, asosan spinoserebellyar sensorimotor vakillik) ancha yirik orqa bo'lakdan (birlamchi va orqa-lateral yoriqlar orasidagi VI–IX bo'lakchalar) ajratadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: What is the correct order of the four deep cerebellar nuclei from LATERAL to MEDIAL?
q.uz: Miyachaning to'rtta chuqur yadrosining LATERALDAN MEDIALGA tomon to'g'ri joylashish tartibi qanday?

options.en: Dentate → Emboliform → Globose → Fastigial
options.uz: Tishsimon (dentatus) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Sharsimon (globosus) → Cho'qqi (fastigii)

options.en: Fastigial → Globose → Emboliform → Dentate
options.uz: Cho'qqi (fastigii) → Sharsimon (globosus) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Tishsimon (dentatus)

options.en: Dentate → Fastigial → Emboliform → Globose
options.uz: Tishsimon (dentatus) → Cho'qqi (fastigii) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Sharsimon (globosus)

options.en: Emboliform → Dentate → Fastigial → Globose
options.uz: Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Tishsimon (dentatus) → Cho'qqi (fastigii) → Sharsimon (globosus)

why.en: Embedded in the cerebellar white matter dorsal to the fourth ventricle, the four paired deep nuclei run from lateral to medial: Dentate (largest, crumpled bag) → Emboliform → Globose (together termed the interposed nucleus) → Fastigial (most medial, near the midline roof of the fourth ventricle). Mnemonic: 'Don't Eat Greasy Food'.
why.uz: To'rtinchi qorincha orqasidagi miyacha oq moddasida joylashgan to'rtta juft chuqur yadro lateraldan medialga quyidagicha joylashadi: Tishsimon (dentatus — eng yirik, burmalangan xaltacha) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Sharsimon (globosus; ikkalasi birgalikda oraliq yadro — nucleus interpositus deyiladi) → Cho'qqi (fastigii — eng medial, IV qorincha tomi o'rta chizig'i yaqinida).

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Which neuron type forms the SOLE output of the three-layered cerebellar cortex, and what is its neurotransmitter action on the deep cerebellar nuclei?
q.uz: Uch qavatli miyacha po'stlog'idan chiquvchi YAGONA efferent neyron turi qaysi va u chuqur yadrolarga qanday neyromediator ta'sir ko'rsatadi?

options.en: Purkinje cells — purely inhibitory (GABAergic) projections to deep nuclei
options.uz: Purkine hujayralari — chuqur yadrolarga sof tormozlovchi (GAMK-ergik) chiqish

options.en: Granule cells — excitatory (glutamatergic) axons leaving via the superior peduncle
options.uz: Donador hujayralar — ustki oyoqcha orqali chiquvchi qo'zg'atuvchi (glutamatergik) aksonlar

options.en: Basket and stellate cells — excitatory projections directly to the motor thalamus
options.uz: Savatcha va yulduzsimon hujayralar — motor talamusga bevosita qo'zg'atuvchi proyeksiyalar

options.en: Golgi cells — inhibitory (glycinergic) projections to the inferior olivary nucleus
options.uz: Golji hujayralari — pastki oliva yadrosiga tormozlovchi (glitsinergik) proyeksiyalar

why.en: The cerebellar cortex has three uniform layers (outer molecular, middle Purkinje cell monolayer, inner granular). Purkinje cells are the sole output neurons of the cerebellar cortex; they use GABA to inhibit the deep cerebellar nuclei (and lateral vestibular nucleus), carving precise timing out of the tonic excitatory drive in the deep nuclei.
why.uz: Miyacha po'stlog'i uchta bir xil qavatdan (tashqi molekulyar, o'rta Purkine hujayralari qavati, ichki donador) iborat. Purkine hujayralari miyacha po'stlog'idan chiquvchi yagona neyronlar bo'lib, GAMK yordamida chuqur miyacha yadrolarini (va lateral vestibulyar yadroni) tormozlaydi hamda chuqur yadrolarning tonik qo'zg'alishini aniq vaqt bo'yicha shakllantiradi.

q.en: Which cerebellar peduncle is the largest, consists exclusively of AFFERENT fibres from the contralateral basilar pontine nuclei, and carries descending cerebral cortical motor plans?
q.uz: Qaysi miyacha oyoqchasi eng yirik bo'lib, faqat qarama-qarshi bazilyar ko'prik yadrolaridan keluvchi AFFERENT tolalardan iborat va katta yarimsharlar po'stlog'ining harakat rejalarini olib keladi?

options.en: Middle cerebellar peduncle (brachium pontis)
options.uz: O'rta miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium pontis)

options.en: Superior cerebellar peduncle (brachium conjunctivum)
options.uz: Ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium conjunctivum)

options.en: Inferior cerebellar peduncle (restiform and juxtarestiform bodies)
options.uz: Pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (arqonsimon va yukstarestiform tanalar)

options.en: Superior medullary velum (velum medullare superius)
options.uz: Ustki miya chodiri (velum medullare superius)

why.en: The middle cerebellar peduncle (MCP / brachium pontis) is a massive, purely afferent white-matter bundle carrying crossed transverse pontocerebellar fibres (the second stage of the corticopontocerebellar pathway) from the contralateral pontine nuclei into the cerebellar hemispheres.
why.uz: O'rta miyacha oyoqchasi (MCP / brachium pontis) yirik, sof afferent oq modda tutami bo'lib, qarama-qarshi ko'prik yadrolaridan kesishgan ko'ndalang pontoserebellyar tolalarni (kortikopontoserebellyar yo'lning ikkinchi bo'g'ini) miyacha yarimsharlariga olib kiradi.

q.en: Which cerebellar peduncle serves as the primary EFFERENT outflow tract of the cerebellum, carrying axons from the dentate and interposed nuclei toward the red nucleus and motor thalamus?
q.uz: Qaysi miyacha oyoqchasi tishsimon va oraliq yadrolardan qizil yadro hamda motor talamusga yo'naluvchi aksonlarni tashib, miyachaning asosiy EFFERENT chiqish yo'li vazifasini bajaradi?

options.en: Superior cerebellar peduncle (brachium conjunctivum)
options.uz: Ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium conjunctivum)

options.en: Middle cerebellar peduncle (brachium pontis)
options.uz: O'rta miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium pontis)

options.en: Inferior cerebellar peduncle (restiform body)
options.uz: Pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (corpus restiforme)

options.en: Ventral cerebral peduncle (crus cerebri)
options.uz: Ventral miya oyoqchasi (crus cerebri)

why.en: The superior cerebellar peduncle (SCP / brachium conjunctivum) forms the principal efferent outflow of the cerebellum. Originating mainly from the dentate, emboliform, and globose nuclei, its fibres ascend in the dorsolateral pontine roof and decussate completely at the caudal midbrain (inferior colliculus level, plate O1) to reach the contralateral red nucleus and VLp (Vim) thalamus.
why.uz: Ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (SCP / brachium conjunctivum) miyachaning asosiy efferent chiqish yo'lidir. Asosan tishsimon, tiqinsimon va sharsimon yadrolardan boshlanib, uning tolalari ko'prik tomining dorsolateral qismida ko'tariladi va kaudal o'rta miyada (pastki tepaliklar sathi, O1 plastinkasi) to'liq kesishib, qarama-qarshi qizil yadro hamda talamusning VLp (Vim) yadrosiga boradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Why does a unilateral lesion of the right cerebellar hemisphere produce ataxia and dysmetria on the SAME (ipsilateral right) side of the body?
q.uz: Nima uchun o'ng miyacha yarimsharining bir tomonlama zararlanishi tananing XUDDI SHU (ipsilateral o'ng) tomonida ataksiya va dismetriya keltirib chiqaradi?

options.en: Double crossing: dentatothalamic fibres cross in the midbrain, and corticospinal fibres cross back in the medulla
options.uz: Ikki marta kesishish: dentatotalamik tolalar o'rta miyada, kortikospinal tolalar esa uzunchoq miyada qayta kesishadi

options.en: Uncrossed loop: neither the dentatothalamic tract nor the lateral corticospinal tract decussates across the midline
options.uz: Kesishmagan halqa: na dentatotalamik yo'l, na lateral kortikospinal yo'l o'rta chiziqni kesib o'tmaydi

options.en: Direct spinal output: right Purkinje cells send uncrossed axons directly down the cord to right alpha motor neurons
options.uz: Bevosita spinal chiqish: o'ng Purkine hujayralari o'ng alfa-motoneyronlarga kesishmagan aksonlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yuboradi

options.en: Single pontine crossing: corticopontine fibres cross once in the pons while all cerebellar efferents stay ipsilateral
options.uz: Yagona ko'prik kesishmasi: kortikopontin tolalar ko'prikda bir marta kesishadi, barcha miyacha efferentlari esa ipsilateral qoladi

why.en: The cerebellum controls the ipsilateral body because of a 'double decussation': (1) ascending dentatothalamic fibres from the right cerebellum cross at the superior cerebellar peduncle decussation in the caudal midbrain to influence the left thalamus, motor cortex, and red nucleus, and (2) the descending lateral corticospinal (and rubrospinal) tracts cross back across the midline at the pyramidal decussation to innervate motor neurons on the right side.
why.uz: Miyacha tananing o'z tomonini (ipsilateral) 'ikki marta kesishish' tufayli boshqaradi: (1) o'ng miyachadan ko'tariluvchi dentatotalamik tolalar kaudal o'rta miyadagi ustki miyacha oyoqchasi kesishmasida chap talamus, motor po'stloq va qizil yadroga o'tadi, va (2) tushuvchi lateral kortikospinal (hamda rubrospinal) yo'llar piramida kesishmasida o'rta chiziqni qayta kesib o'tib, o'ng tomondagi motoneyronlarni innervatsiya qiladi.

q.en: What is the 'arbor vitae' ('tree of life') seen on a midsagittal section of the cerebellum?
q.uz: Miyachaning o'rta sagittal kesimida ko'rinadigan 'arbor vitae' ('hayot daraxti') nima?

options.en: The branching medullary core of cerebellar white matter extending into the folia
options.uz: Miyacha bargchalariga (folia) shoxlanib kiruvchi markaziy oq modda o'zagi

options.en: The choroid plexus vascular tuft lining the inferior roof of the fourth ventricle
options.uz: To'rtinchi qorincha pastki tomini qoplovchi xoroid chigal tomir tutami

options.en: The flattened dendritic tree of a single Purkinje cell in the molecular layer
options.uz: Molekulyar qavatdagi bitta Purkine hujayrasining yassilangan dendrit daraxti

options.en: The pial arterial arborization of the posterior inferior cerebellar artery
options.uz: Orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasining yumshoq parda yuzasidagi shoxlanishi

why.en: On a sagittal cut through the vermis, the central white matter (corpus medullare, housing the deep cerebellar nuclei) branches into primary and secondary laminae inside the grey-matter folia, creating a fern- or tree-like silhouette historically named the arbor vitae ('tree of life').
why.uz: Chuvalchang orqali o'tgan sagittal kesimda markaziy oq modda (corpus medullare, ichida chuqur yadrolarni saqlaydi) kulrang modda bargchalari (folia) ichiga birlamchi va ikkilamchi plastinkalar bo'lib shoxlanadi va tarixan 'arbor vitae' ('hayot daraxti') deb atalgan daraxtsimon siluetni hosil qiladi.

q.en: Which functional division of the cerebellum occupies the vermis and paravermal (intermediate) zone and receives continuous somatosensory feedback from the spinal cord to adjust posture and ongoing limb movement?
q.uz: Miyachaning qaysi funksional bo'limi chuvalchang va paravermal (oraliq) zonani egallab, tana holati va davom etayotgan qo'l-oyoq harakatlarini to'g'rilash uchun orqa miyadan uzluksiz somatosensor qayta aloqa oladi?

options.en: Spinocerebellum (paleocerebellum) — projecting via the fastigial and interposed nuclei
options.uz: Spinoserebellum (paleoserebellum) — cho'qqi va oraliq yadrolar orqali proyeksiya beradi

options.en: Cerebrocerebellum (neocerebellum) — lateral hemispheres projecting via the dentate nucleus
options.uz: Serebroserebellum (neoserebellum) — tishsimon yadro orqali proyeksiya beruvchi yarimsharlar

options.en: Vestibulocerebellum (archicerebellum) — flocculonodular lobe projecting to vestibular nuclei
options.uz: Vestibuloserebellum (arxiserebellum) — vestibulyar yadrolarga chiquvchi flokkulonodulyar bo'lak

options.en: Pontocerebellum — posterior lobe Crus I/II projecting via the middle cerebellar peduncle
options.uz: Pontoserebellum — o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi orqali proyeksiya beruvchi orqa bo'lak Crus I/II

why.en: The spinocerebellum (paleocerebellum) comprises the midline vermis (controlling axial and proximal musculature via the fastigial nucleus) and the adjacent intermediate/paravermal cortex (controlling distal limb execution via the interposed [globose + emboliform] nuclei), heavily represented in the anterior lobe (I–V) and lobule VIII.
why.uz: Spinoserebellum (paleoserebellum) o'rta chiziqdagi chuvalchang (cho'qqi yadrosi orqali tana o'qi va proksimal mushaklarni boshqaradi) hamda unga tutash oraliq/paravermal po'stloqdan (oraliq [sharsimon + tiqinsimon] yadrolar orqali distal oyoq-qo'l harakatlarini boshqaradi) iborat bo'lib, oldingi bo'lakda (I–V) va VIII bo'lakchada keng namoyon bo'lgan.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Which is the largest and phylogenetically newest division of the human cerebellum, greatly expanded in the posterior lobe (lobules VI, Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) and projecting through the dentate nucleus?
q.uz: Inson miyachasining orqa bo'lakda (VI, Crus I, Crus II, VIIb bo'lakchalar) keskin kengaygan va tishsimon yadro orqali proyeksiya beradigan eng yirik hamda filogenetik eng yangi bo'limi qaysi?

options.en: Lateral cerebellar hemispheres (cerebrocerebellum)
options.uz: Lateral yarimsharlar (serebroserebellum / neoserebellum)

options.en: Anterior vermian lobules I–III (lingula and centralis)
options.uz: Oldingi chuvalchangning I–III bo'lakchalari (lingula va centralis)

options.en: Flocculonodular lobe (archicerebellum / lobule X)
options.uz: Flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (arxiserebellum / X bo'lakcha)

options.en: Paravermal intermediate strip (spinocerebellar zone)
options.uz: Paravermal oraliq tasma (spinoserebellyar zona)

why.en: The cerebrocerebellum (neocerebellum) comprises the expansive lateral cerebellar hemispheres (especially lobules VI, Crus I, Crus II, and VIIb of the posterior lobe). It receives massive corticopontocerebellar input via the middle cerebellar peduncle and projects via the dentate nucleus and superior cerebellar peduncle to motor, prefrontal, and parietal association thalamocortical loops, supporting motor planning, skilled coordination, and executive/language cognition.
why.uz: Serebroserebellum (neoserebellum) miyachaning keng lateral yarimsharlaridan (ayniqsa orqa bo'lakning VI, Crus I, Crus II va VIIb bo'lakchalari) iborat. U o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi orqali katta hajmdagi kortikopontoserebellyar signallarni qabul qiladi va tishsimon yadro hamda ustki miyacha oyoqchasi orqali motor, prefrontal va parietal assotsiativ talamokortikal halqalarga proyeksiya berib, harakatni rejalashtirish, nozik koordinatsiya va ijrochi/nutq kognitsiyasini ta'minlaydi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: How do climbing fibres and mossy fibres differ in their anatomical origin, synaptic target, and firing pattern on Purkinje cells?
q.uz: Chirmashuvchi tolalar (climbing fibers) va yo'sinsimon tolalar (mossy fibers) o'zlarining anatomik manbasi, sinaptik nishoni hamda Purkine hujayralaridagi impuls berish xususiyati bilan qanday farq qiladi?

options.en: Climbing fibres: contralateral inferior olive → Purkinje dendrites (complex spikes); mossy fibres: spinal/pontine/vestibular → granule cells (simple spikes)
options.uz: Chirmashuvchi: qarama-qarshi pastki oliva → Purkine dendritlari (murakkab spayklar); yo'sinsimon: orqa miya/ko'prik/vestibulyar → donador hujayralar (oddiy spayklar)

options.en: Mossy fibres: contralateral inferior olive → Purkinje cell somata (complex spikes); climbing fibres: basilar pontine nuclei → granule cells (simple spikes)
options.uz: Yo'sinsimon: qarama-qarshi pastki oliva → Purkine tanasi (murakkab spayklar); chirmashuvchi: bazilyar ko'prik yadrolari → donador hujayralar (oddiy spayklar)

options.en: Climbing fibres: ipsilateral red nucleus → basket interneurons (GABAergic inhibition); mossy fibres: dentate nucleus → stellate cells (burst firing)
options.uz: Chirmashuvchi: ipsilateral qizil yadro → savatcha interneyronlari (GAMK tormozlash); yo'sinsimon: tishsimon yadro → yulduzsimon hujayralar (tutamli razryad)

options.en: Climbing fibres: middle cerebellar peduncle → Golgi cells (tonic simple spikes); mossy fibres: superior medullary velum → Purkinje axons (complex spikes)
options.uz: Chirmashuvchi: o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi → Golji hujayralari (tonik oddiy spayklar); yo'sinsimon: ustki miya chodiri → Purkine aksonlari (murakkab spayklar)

why.en: Climbing fibres originate exclusively in the contralateral inferior olivary complex, enter via the inferior cerebellar peduncle, and wrap 1:1 around Purkinje cell dendritic trees in the molecular layer to evoke powerful, low-frequency 'complex spikes' (error/teaching signals). All other cerebellar afferents (pontine, spinocerebellar, vestibular, reticular) enter as mossy fibres, exciting granule cells whose T-shaped parallel fibres contact hundreds of thousands of Purkinje cells to drive high-frequency 'simple spikes'.
why.uz: Chirmashuvchi tolalar faqat qarama-qarshi pastki oliva majmuasidan boshlanadi, pastki miyacha oyoqchasi orqali kiradi va molekulyar qavatda Purkine hujayralari dendrit daraxtiga 1:1 nisbatda o'ralib, kuchli, past chastotali 'murakkab spayklar'ni (xato/o'rgatuvchi signallar) chaqiradi. Qolgan barcha afferentlar (ko'prik, spinoserebellyar, vestibulyar, retikulyar) yo'sinsimon tolalar sifatida kirib, donador hujayralarni qo'zg'atadi; ularning T-simon parallel tolalari yuz minglab Purkine hujayralari bilan tutashib, yuqori chastotali 'oddiy spayklar'ni hosil qiladi.

q.en: Contrast the anatomical trajectories of the dorsal spinocerebellar tract (DSCT) and ventral spinocerebellar tract (VSCT) on their way to the spinocerebellum:
q.uz: Spinoserebellumga yo'naluvchi dorsal spinoserebellyar yo'l (DSCT) va ventral spinoserebellyar yo'l (VSCT) anatomik yo'nalishlarini taqqoslang:

options.en: DSCT ascends ipsilaterally via the ICP; VSCT crosses in the cord, enters via the SCP, and crosses back inside the cerebellum
options.uz: DSCT ICP orqali ipsilateral kiradi; VSCT orqa miyada kesishadi, SCP orqali kiradi va miyacha ichida qayta kesishadi

options.en: DSCT crosses in the cord and enters via the MCP; VSCT ascends ipsilaterally from Clarke's column and enters via the ICP
options.uz: DSCT orqa miyada kesishib MCP orqali kiradi; VSCT Klark ustunidan ipsilateral ko'tarilib ICP orqali kiradi

options.en: Both DSCT and VSCT decussate at the medullary pyramidal decussation and terminate directly in the contralateral dentate nucleus
options.uz: DSCT va VSCT ning ikkalasi ham uzunchoq miya piramida kesishmasida kesishib, qarama-qarshi tishsimon yadroda tugaydi

options.en: DSCT enters via the juxtarestiform body for upper-limb proprioception; VSCT enters via the restiform body for vestibular input
options.uz: DSCT qo'l propriotsepsiyasi uchun yukstarestiform tanadan; VSCT esa vestibulyar signal uchun arqonsimon tanadan kiradi

why.en: The dorsal spinocerebellar tract (DSCT) arises from Clarke's column (T1–L2, lower limb and trunk muscle spindles), ascends uncrossed, and enters the cerebellum via the inferior cerebellar peduncle (ICP). The ventral spinocerebellar tract (VSCT, conveying spinal interneuron and Golgi tendon organ copy) crosses in the anterior white commissure of the cord, ascends to enter via the superior cerebellar peduncle (SCP), and crosses a second time within the cerebellar white matter ('double-crosser') so both tracts ultimately represent the ipsilateral body.
why.uz: Dorsal spinoserebellyar yo'l (DSCT) Klark ustunidan (T1–L2, oyoq va tana mushak dukchalari) boshlanib, kesishmasdan ko'tariladi va pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (ICP) orqali kiradi. Ventral spinoserebellyar yo'l (VSCT, orqa miya oraliq neyronlari va Golji pay reseptorlari nusxasi) orqa miyada oldingi oq bitishmada kesishadi, ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (SCP) orqali kiradi va miyacha oq moddasida ikkinchi marta kesishadi ('ikki marta kesishuvchi') — natijada ikkala yo'l ham tananing o'z (ipsilateral) tomonini aks ettiradi.

q.en: Because Clarke's column ends above C8, how does unconscious proprioceptive information from the UPPER limb and neck reach the spinocerebellum?
q.uz: Klark ustuni C8 dan yuqorida tugashi sababli, QO'L va bo'yindan keluvchi ongsiz propriotseptiv axborot spinoserebellumga qaysi yo'l orqali yetib boradi?

options.en: Cuneocerebellar tract from the lateral (accessory) cuneate nucleus via the ipsilateral ICP
options.uz: Lateral (qo'shimcha) ponasimon yadrodan ipsilateral ICP orqali chiquvchi kuneoserebellyar yo'l

options.en: Medial lemniscus from the main cuneate nucleus crossing to enter the contralateral MCP
options.uz: Asosiy ponasimon yadrodan kesishib qarama-qarshi MCP ga kiruvchi medial qovuzloq

options.en: Rostral spinocerebellar fibres descending from the red nucleus in the central tegmental tract
options.uz: Qizil yadrodan markaziy tegmental yo'l bo'ylab tushuvchi rostral spinoserebellyar tolalar

options.en: Fasciculus gracilis projecting uncrossed through the juxtarestiform body to the fastigial nucleus
options.uz: Yukstarestiform tana orqali cho'qqi yadrosiga kesishmasdan boruvchi nozik tutam

why.en: The lateral (external or accessory) cuneate nucleus in the dorsolateral medulla is the upper-limb homologue of Clarke's column. It receives C1–T5 proprioceptive afferents ascending in the fasciculus cuneatus and sends uncrossed cuneocerebellar mossy fibres into the cerebellum via the inferior cerebellar peduncle (restiform body).
why.uz: Dorsolateral uzunchoq miyadagi lateral (tashqi yoki qo'shimcha) ponasimon yadro Klark ustunining qo'l uchun gomologidir. U ponasimon tutamda ko'tariluvchi C1–T5 propriotseptiv tolalarni qabul qiladi va kesishmagan kuneoserebellyar yo'sinsimon tolalarni pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (arqonsimon tana) orqali miyachaga yuboradi.

q.en: How are the two sensorimotor body representations (somatotopic homunculi) organized in the human cerebellar cortex according to probabilistic fMRI/MR mapping?
q.uz: Ehtimoliy fMRI/MR xaritalashga ko'ra, inson miyacha po'stlog'idagi ikkita sensorimotor tana xaritasi (somatotopik gomunkuluslar) qayerda joylashgan?

options.en: Inverted map in the anterior lobe (lobules I–VI) and upright map in lobule VIII, separated by Crus I/II
options.uz: Oldingi bo'lakda (I–VI bo'lakchalar) teskari xarita va VIII bo'lakchada to'g'ri xarita, orasida Crus I/II

options.en: A single upright motor homunculus restricted entirely to the flocculonodular lobe (lobule X) and tonsils
options.uz: Butunlay flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha) va bodomchalarda joylashgan yagona to'g'ri motor xarita

options.en: Contralateral maps where the left body is represented in the right anterior lobe and right posterior lobe
options.uz: Chap tana o'ng oldingi va o'ng orqa bo'laklarda ifodalangan kontralateral somatotopik xaritalar

options.en: Primary sensorimotor representation in Crus I and Crus II, with executive cognition confined to lobules I–IV
options.uz: Birlamchi sensorimotor vakillik Crus I va Crus II da, ijrochi kognitsiya esa faqat I–IV bo'lakchalarda

why.en: Human neuroimaging (Diedrichsen et al. 2009) confirms two distinct ipsilateral sensorimotor body maps: an inverted map in the anterior lobe (leg in lobules I–IV, hand in V, face/lips extending into VI) and a second upright map in lobule VIII (VIIIa/VIIIb). Between them, the massive expansion of lobule VII (Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) connects with prefrontal and parietal association cortices rather than primary motor cortex.
why.uz: Inson neyrovizualizatsiyasi (Diedrichsen va boshq., 2009) ikkita alohida ipsilateral sensorimotor tana xaritasini tasdiqlaydi: oldingi bo'lakdagi teskari xarita (oyoq I–IV bo'lakchalarda, qo'l V da, yuz/lablar VI gacha davom etadi) va VIII bo'lakchadagi (VIIIa/VIIIb) ikkinchi to'g'ri xarita. Ularning orasida kengaygan VII bo'lakcha (Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) birlamchi motor po'stloq bilan emas, balki prefrontal va parietal assotsiativ po'stloq bilan bog'langan.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Match each deep cerebellar nucleus with its primary downstream efferent target:
q.uz: Miyachaning har bir chuqur yadrosini uning asosiy efferent nishoni bilan moslang:

options.en: Fastigial → vestibular/reticular; Interposed → magnocellular red nucleus & VL; Dentate → parvocellular red nucleus & VLp (Vim)
options.uz: Cho'qqi → vestibulyar/retikulyar; Oraliq → yirik hujayrali qizil yadro va VL; Tishsimon → mayda hujayrali qizil yadro va VLp (Vim)

options.en: Fastigial → prefrontal MD thalamus; Interposed → Edinger–Westphal & superior colliculus; Dentate → lateral vestibular nucleus
options.uz: Cho'qqi → prefrontal MD talamus; Oraliq → Edinger–Vestfal va ustki tepalik; Tishsimon → lateral vestibulyar yadro

options.en: Fastigial → contralateral inferior olive; Interposed → ipsilateral pontine nuclei; Dentate → direct spinal alpha motor neurons
options.uz: Cho'qqi → qarama-qarshi pastki oliva; Oraliq → ipsilateral ko'prik yadrolari; Tishsimon → bevosita spinal alfa-motoneyronlar

options.en: Fastigial → parvocellular red nucleus & Vim; Interposed → vestibular & reticular nuclei; Dentate → magnocellular red nucleus
options.uz: Cho'qqi → mayda hujayrali qizil yadro va Vim; Oraliq → vestibulyar va retikulyar yadrolar; Tishsimon → yirik hujayrali qizil yadro

why.en: Each longitudinal zone has a dedicated nuclear outflow: (1) medial vermis → fastigial nucleus → bilateral vestibular nuclei and pontomedullary reticular formation (via juxtarestiform body and uncinate fasciculus of Russell); (2) paravermis → interposed (globose + emboliform) nuclei → SCP → contralateral magnocellular red nucleus (rubrospinal) and VL thalamus; (3) lateral hemisphere → dentate nucleus → SCP → contralateral VLp/Vim (and VA) thalamus (to motor/premotor/prefrontal cortex) and parvocellular red nucleus (to inferior olive).
why.uz: Har bir bo'ylama zona o'z yadroviy chiqish yo'liga ega: (1) medial chuvalchang → cho'qqi yadrosi → ikki tomonlama vestibulyar yadrolar va pontomedullyar retikulyar formatsiya (yukstarestiform tana va Rasselning ilmoqsimon tutami orqali); (2) paravermis → oraliq (sharsimon + tiqinsimon) yadrolar → SCP → qarama-qarshi yirik hujayrali qizil yadro (rubrospinal) va VL talamus; (3) lateral yarimshar → tishsimon yadro → SCP → qarama-qarshi VLp/Vim (va VA) talamus (motor/premotor/prefrontal po'stloqqa) va mayda hujayrali qizil yadro (pastki olivaga).

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Which midline cerebellar region constitutes the 'oculomotor vermis', calibrating saccadic eye-movement amplitude and smooth pursuit via the caudal fastigial nucleus?
q.uz: O'rta chiziqdagi qaysi miyacha sohasi kaudal cho'qqi yadrosi orqali sakkadik ko'z harakatlari amplitudasini va silliq kuzatuvni kalibrlaydigan 'okulomotor chuvalchang'ni tashkil etadi?

options.en: Posterior superior vermis — lobules VI and VII (declive, folium, tuber)
options.uz: Orqa ustki chuvalchang — VI va VII bo'lakchalar (declive, folium, tuber)

options.en: Anterior superior vermis — lobules I–IV (lingula, centralis, culmen)
options.uz: Oldingi ustki chuvalchang — I–IV bo'lakchalar (lingula, centralis, culmen)

options.en: Lateral posterior hemisphere — Crus I and Crus II (neocerebellar zone)
options.uz: Lateral orqa yarimshar — Crus I va Crus II (neoserebellyar zona)

options.en: Inferior vermis and tonsils — lobules VIII and IX (pyramis and uvula)
options.uz: Pastki chuvalchang va bodomchalar — VIII va IX bo'lakchalar (pyramis, uvula)

why.en: Vermian lobules VI and VII (declive, folium, tuber — together termed the oculomotor vermis) project to the caudal fastigial nucleus (fastigial oculomotor region, FOR) to calibrate saccadic accuracy. Lesions here produce saccadic dysmetria (hypermetric or hypometric saccades) and impaired smooth pursuit, complementing the flocculus/nodulus (lobule X) which stabilizes the vestibulo-ocular reflex and gaze holding.
why.uz: Chuvalchangning VI va VII bo'lakchalari (declive, folium, tuber — birgalikda okulomotor chuvalchang deyiladi) sakkada aniqligini sozlash uchun kaudal cho'qqi yadrosiga (cho'qqi okulomotor sohasi, FOR) proyeksiya beradi. Bu sohaning zararlanishi sakkadik dismetriya (gipermetrik yoki gipometrik sakkadalar) va silliq kuzatuv buzilishini chaqiradi; flokkulus/nodulus (X bo'lakcha) esa vestibulo-okulyar refleks va nigohni ushlab turishni barqarorlashtiradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Chronic alcoholism and thiamine deficiency selectively degenerate Purkinje cells in which cerebellar region, and what is the signature clinical deficit?
q.uz: Surunkali alkogolizm va tiamin yetishmovchiligi miyachaning qaysi sohasidagi Purkine hujayralarini tanlab yemirilishiga olib keladi va uning xos klinik belgisi nima?

options.en: Anterior superior vermis (lobules I–V) — wide-based truncal and gait ataxia with relatively spared arms and speech
options.uz: Oldingi ustki chuvalchang (I–V bo'lakchalar) — qo'l va nutq nisbatan saqlangan holda keng qadamli tana va yurish ataksiyasi

options.en: Lateral posterior lobe (Crus I and Crus II) — isolated upper-limb intention tremor and scanning dysarthria with normal gait
options.uz: Lateral orqa bo'lak (Crus I va Crus II) — yurish normal qolgan holda yakka qo'l intension tremori va skanerlovchi dizartriya

options.en: Flocculonodular lobe (lobule X) — bilateral sensorineural hearing loss and peripheral facial palsy with normal stance
options.uz: Flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha) — turish barqaror qolgan holda ikki tomonlama neyrosensor karlik va yuz falaji

options.en: Bilateral dentate nuclei and SCP — acute symptomatic palatal myoclonus and pendular nystagmus without gait ataxia
options.uz: Ikki tomonlama tishsimon yadrolar va SCP — yurish ataksiyasisiz o'tkir simptomatik tanglay mioklonusi va mayatniksimon nistagm

why.en: Alcoholic/nutritional cerebellar degeneration preferentially causes atrophy of the anterior superior vermis (lobules I–V), where the lower limbs and trunk are somatotopically represented in the inverted anterior-lobe map. Patients present with prominent wide-based stance and gait ataxia and heel-to-shin dysmetria, while upper-limb finger-to-nose coordination and oculomotor/speech functions remain comparatively preserved.
why.uz: Alkogolli/alimentar miyacha degeneratsiyasi asosan oldingi ustki chuvalchangning (I–V bo'lakchalar) atrofiyasini chaqiradi; oldingi bo'lakning teskari somatotopik xaritasida aynan shu joyda oyoqlar va tana gavdasi joylashgan. Bemorlarda keng qadamli turish va yurish ataksiyasi hamda tovon-boldir sinamasida dismetriya yaqqol namoyon bo'ladi, qo'lning barmoq-burun koordinatsiyasi va nutq esa nisbatan saqlanib qoladi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: How do the three pairs of cerebellar arteries (SCA, AICA, PICA) divide the blood supply of the cerebellar cortex, peduncles, and deep nuclei?
q.uz: Uch juft miyacha arteriyasi (SCA, AICA, PICA) miyacha po'stlog'i, oyoqchalari va chuqur yadrolarining qon ta'minotini qanday taqsimlaydi?

options.en: SCA: superior surface, SCP, dentate; AICA: anteroinferior surface, flocculus, MCP; PICA: posteroinferior surface, tonsils, ICP
options.uz: SCA: ustki yuza, SCP, tishsimon yadro; AICA: old-pastki yuza, flokkulus, MCP; PICA: orqa-pastki yuza, bodomchalar, ICP

options.en: SCA: posteroinferior surface, tonsils, ICP; AICA: superior surface, SCP, dentate; PICA: anteroinferior surface, flocculus, MCP
options.uz: SCA: orqa-pastki yuza, bodomchalar, ICP; AICA: ustki yuza, SCP, tishsimon yadro; PICA: old-pastki yuza, flokkulus, MCP

options.en: SCA: anterior lobe and MCP only; AICA: dentate nucleus and ICP only; PICA: flocculus, labyrinth, and superior cerebellar surface
options.uz: SCA: faqat oldingi bo'lak va MCP; AICA: faqat tishsimon yadro va ICP; PICA: flokkulus, ichki quloq va ustki miyacha yuzasi

options.en: SCA: superior vermis and ICP; AICA: entire posterior lobe and tonsils (IX); PICA: deep cerebellar nuclei, SCP, and basis pontis
options.uz: SCA: ustki chuvalchang va ICP; AICA: butun orqa bo'lak va bodomchalar (IX); PICA: chuqur yadrolar, SCP va ko'prik asosi

why.en: From rostral to caudal in the vertebrobasilar system: (1) Superior cerebellar artery (SCA, off distal basilar) supplies the superior cortex (anterior lobe + superior posterior lobe), SCP, and deep nuclei (especially dentate); (2) Anterior inferior cerebellar artery (AICA, off caudal basilar) supplies the petrosal/anteroinferior surface, flocculus, MCP, and labyrinthine artery; (3) Posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA, off vertebral) supplies the suboccipital/posteroinferior surface, inferior vermis, tonsils (lobule IX), ICP, and fourth-ventricle choroid plexus.
why.uz: Vertebrobazilyar tizimda rostraldan kaudalga: (1) Ustki miyacha arteriyasi (SCA, distal bazilyar arteriyadan) ustki po'stloqni (oldingi bo'lak + orqa bo'lak ustki qismi), SCP va chuqur yadrolarni (ayniqsa tishsimon yadroni) ta'minlaydi; (2) Oldingi pastki miyacha arteriyasi (AICA, kaudal bazilyar arteriyadan) old-pastki yuzani, flokkulusni, MCP va labirint arteriyasini ta'minlaydi; (3) Orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasi (PICA, umurtqa arteriyasidan) orqa-pastki yuzani, pastki chuvalchangni, bodomchalarni (IX bo'lakcha), ICP va IV qorincha xoroid chigalini ta'minlaydi.

q.en: Which cerebellar lobule forms the cerebellar tonsils on the ventromedial inferior surface, and why is an expansile posterior fossa mass a contraindication to lumbar puncture?
q.uz: Pastki ventromedial yuzadagi miyacha bodomchalarini (tonsilla cerebelli) qaysi bo'lakcha hosil qiladi va nima uchun orqa kalla chuqurchasidagi hajmli hosila bel punksiyasi uchun qarshi ko'rsatma hisoblanadi?

options.en: Lobule IX — lowering lumbar CSF pressure drives tonsillar herniation through the foramen magnum, compressing the medulla
options.uz: IX bo'lakcha — belda likvor bosimini tushirish bodomchalarni katta ensa teshigiga tiqib, uzunchoq miyani ezib qo'yadi

options.en: Lobule I (lingula) — lowering lumbar CSF pressure pulls the anterior vermis upward through the tentorial notch into the midbrain
options.uz: I bo'lakcha (lingula) — belda likvor bosimini tushirish oldingi chuvalchangni chodir teshigi orqali yuqoriga o'rta miyaga tortadi

options.en: Lobule X (flocculus) — lowering lumbar CSF pressure forces the flocculus laterally into the cerebellopontine angle cistern
options.uz: X bo'lakcha (flokkulus) — belda likvor bosimini tushirish flokkulusni lateral yo'nalishda ko'prik-miyacha burchagiga siqib chiqaradi

options.en: Lobule VIII (biventer) — lowering lumbar CSF pressure collapses the fourth ventricle and ruptures the superior medullary velum
options.uz: VIII bo'lakcha (biventer) — belda likvor bosimini tushirish IV qorinchani puchaytirib, ustki miya chodirini yirtib yuboradi

why.en: Hemispheric lobule IX corresponds to the cerebellar tonsils (flanking the midline vermian uvula, directly above the foramen magnum). In Chiari I malformation or posterior fossa mass lesions, withdrawing lumbar CSF creates a craniospinal pressure gradient that drives the tonsils downward through the foramen magnum ('coning'), acutely compressing the vital medullary cardiorespiratory and vasomotor centres.
why.uz: Yarimsharning IX bo'lakchasi miyacha bodomchalariga (o'rta chiziqdagi chuvalchang tilchasi — uvula ikki yonida, bevosita katta ensa teshigi ustida) to'g'ri keladi. Kiari I malformatsiyasida yoki orqa kalla chuqurchasi hajmli hosilalarida beldan likvor olish kraniospinal bosim gradiyentini yuzaga keltirib, bodomchalarni katta ensa teshigi orqali pastga suradi ('ponalanish') va uzunchoq miyaning hayotiy muhim yurak-nafas hamda vazomotor markazlarini o'tkir ezib qo'yadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: How do cerebellar afferents and efferents use the two subdivisions of the inferior cerebellar peduncle — the restiform body and the juxtarestiform body?
q.uz: Miyacha afferent va efferent tolalari pastki miyacha oyoqchasining ikkita qismidan — arqonsimon tana (corpus restiforme) va yukstarestiform tanadan qanday foydalanadi?

options.en: Restiform body is purely afferent (DSCT, cuneocerebellar, olivocerebellar); juxtarestiform body is bidirectional (vestibular/fastigial)
options.uz: Arqonsimon tana sof afferent (DSCT, kuneoserebellyar, olivoserebellyar); yukstarestiform tana ikki yo'nalishli (vestibulyar/cho'qqi)

options.en: Restiform body carries dentatothalamic efferents to the thalamus; juxtarestiform body carries crossed pontocerebellar afferents
options.uz: Arqonsimon tana talamusga dentatotalamik efferentlarni; yukstarestiform tana esa kesishgan pontoserebellyar afferentlarni tashiydi

options.en: Restiform body is purely efferent (fastigioreticular and rubrocerebellar); juxtarestiform body is purely afferent (ventral spinocerebellar)
options.uz: Arqonsimon tana sof efferent (fastigioretikulyar va rubroserebellyar); yukstarestiform tana esa sof afferent (ventral spinoserebellyar)

options.en: Both subdivisions are purely afferent, conveying mossy fibres from the basilar pontine nuclei and climbing fibres from the red nucleus
options.uz: Ikkala qism ham sof afferent bo'lib, bazilyar ko'prik yadrolaridan yo'sinsimon tolalarni va qizil yadrodan chirmashuvchi tolalarni tashiydi

why.en: The inferior cerebellar peduncle (ICP) has two parts: (1) the larger lateral restiform body is purely afferent (dorsal spinocerebellar, cuneocerebellar, trigeminocerebellar, and crossed olivocerebellar climbing fibres); (2) the smaller medial juxtarestiform body is bidirectional, carrying primary/secondary vestibular afferents to the flocculonodular lobe and Purkinje/fastigial efferents back to the vestibular nuclei and reticular formation.
why.uz: Pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (ICP) ikki qismdan iborat: (1) yirikroq lateral arqonsimon tana (corpus restiforme) sof afferent bo'lib, dorsal spinoserebellyar, kuneoserebellyar, trigeminoserebellyar va kesishgan olivoserebellyar chirmashuvchi tolalarni olib kiradi; (2) kichikroq medial yukstarestiform tana ikki yo'nalishli bo'lib, flokkulonodulyar bo'lakka vestibulyar afferentlarni va u yerdan Purkine/cho'qqi yadrosi efferentlarini vestibulyar yadrolar hamda retikulyar formatsiyaga qaytarib olib chiqadi.

q.en: Compare Patient A (7-year-old with a fourth-ventricle roof tumour: severe truncal ataxia, falling backward while sitting, titubation, and downbeat nystagmus, but normal supine finger-to-nose) with Patient B (62-year-old with right arm intention tremor, past-pointing, dysdiadochokinesia, and ipsilateral hypotonia). Where are the two lesions?
q.uz: A bemorni (IV qorincha tomi o'smasi bor 7 yoshli bola: og'ir tana ataksiyasi, o'tirganda orqaga yiqilish, titubatsiya va pastga uruvchi nistagm, ammo yotganda barmoq-burun sinamasi normal) B bemor bilan (o'ng qo'lda intension tremor, mo'ljaldan o'tib ketish, disdiadoxokineziya va ipsilateral gipotoniya bor 62 yoshli bemor) taqqoslang. Ikkala o'choq qayerda joylashgan?

options.en: Patient A: midline vermis / flocculonodular lobe (fastigial); Patient B: right lateral hemisphere / right dentate nucleus
options.uz: A bemor: o'rta chiziq chuvalchangi / flokkulonodulyar bo'lak; B bemor: o'ng lateral yarimshar / o'ng tishsimon yadro

options.en: Patient A: left lateral cerebellar hemisphere / left dentate; Patient B: left lateral hemisphere (contralateral to right arm)
options.uz: A bemor: chap lateral miyacha yarimshari / chap tishsimon yadro; B bemor: chap lateral yarimshar (o'ng qo'lga qarama-qarshi)

options.en: Patient A: bilateral dentate nuclei and superior peduncles; Patient B: midline flocculonodular lobe and nodulus (lobule X)
options.uz: A bemor: ikki tomonlama tishsimon yadrolar va ustki oyoqchalar; B bemor: o'rta chiziq flokkulonodulyar bo'lagi (X bo'lakcha)

options.en: Patient A: right anterior paravermal lobe (interposed nuclei); Patient B: left ventral lateral thalamus and internal capsule
options.uz: A bemor: o'ng oldingi paravermal bo'lak (oraliq yadrolar); B bemor: chap ventral lateral talamus va ichki kapsula

why.en: Midline vermian / flocculonodular lesions (classic in childhood medulloblastoma invading the nodulus X and fastigial nucleus at the fourth-ventricle roof) disrupt axial and vestibular control, causing truncal ataxia (inability to sit or stand without support), head/trunk titubation, and downbeat nystagmus while sparing supine appendicular coordination. Lateral hemispheric / dentate lesions (Patient B) disrupt the ipsilateral cerebrocerebellar loop, producing appendicular dysmetria, kinetic/intention tremor, dysdiadochokinesia, and hypotonia on the same (right) side.
why.uz: O'rta chiziq chuvalchang / flokkulonodulyar zararlanishlar (bolalikdagi medulloblastomaning IV qorincha tomidagi nodulus X va cho'qqi yadrosiga o'sib kirishiga xos) tana o'qi va vestibulyar boshqaruvni izdan chiqarib, yotganda qo'l-oyoq koordinatsiyasi saqlangan holda tana ataksiyasi, bosh/tana titubatsiyasi va pastga uruvchi nistagmni chaqiradi. Lateral yarimshar / tishsimon yadro zararlanishi (B bemor) esa ipsilateral serebroserebellyar halqani buzib, xuddi shu (o'ng) tomonda qo'l-oyoq dismetriyasi, intension tremor, disdiadoxokineziya va gipotoniyani yuzaga keltiradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Trace the Guillain–Mollaret triangle (dentato-rubro-olivary circuit). Why does a right dentate (or right SCP) haemorrhage cause delayed HYPERTROPHIC degeneration of the LEFT inferior olive, whereas a left ICP lesion does NOT?
q.uz: Giyen–Mollare uchburchagini (dentato-rubro-olivar halqa) kuzating. Nima uchun o'ng tishsimon yadro (yoki o'ng SCP) qon quyilishi kechikkan CHAP pastki oliva GIPERTROFIK degeneratsiyasini chaqiradi, chap ICP zararlanishi esa CHAQIRMAYDI?

options.en: Right dentate → crossed SCP → LEFT red nucleus → LEFT CTT → LEFT olive; dentate/SCP/CTT lesions deafferent the olive, whereas ICP is post-olivary
options.uz: O'ng tishsimon → SCP kesishmasi → CHAP qizil yadro → CHAP CTT → CHAP oliva; dentat/SCP/CTT olivani deafferentatsiya qiladi, ICP esa efferent

options.en: Right dentate → uncrossed MCP → right red nucleus → crossed CTT → LEFT olive; ICP lesions are spared because climbing fibres regenerate rapidly
options.uz: O'ng tishsimon → kesishmagan MCP → o'ng qizil yadro → kesishgan CTT → CHAP oliva; ICP da esa chirmashuvchi tolalar tez regeneratsiya qiladi

options.en: Right dentate → crossed ICP → LEFT red nucleus → LEFT medial lemniscus → LEFT olive; hypertrophy occurs only when excitatory inputs are cut
options.uz: O'ng tishsimon → kesishgan ICP → CHAP qizil yadro → CHAP medial qovuzloq → CHAP oliva; gipertrofiya faqat qo'zg'atuvchi kirish uzilganda bo'ladi

options.en: Right dentate → uncrossed CTT → right inferior olive → crossed SCP → LEFT olive; ICP lesions cause acute olivary atrophy rather than hypertrophy
options.uz: O'ng tishsimon → kesishmagan CTT → o'ng oliva → kesishgan SCP → CHAP oliva; ICP zararlanishi gipertrofiya emas, o'tkir oliva atrofiyasini beradi

why.en: The Guillain–Mollaret triangle is unidirectional: (1) Dentate nucleus → ascends via SCP and crosses at the caudal midbrain decussation (plate O1) to the contralateral parvocellular red nucleus; (2) Red nucleus → descends ipsilaterally in the central tegmental tract (CTT) to the inferior olivary nucleus (ION); (3) ION → sends climbing fibres across the midline via the ICP back to the original dentate/Purkinje cortex. Interrupting the first two afferent limbs (dentate/SCP or contralateral CTT) deafferents the ION, causing unique trans-synaptic vacuolar olivary enlargement/T2 hyperintensity and ~2 Hz symptomatic oculopalatal tremor months later. Interrupting the third limb (ICP) cuts post-olivary efferent axons rather than olivary inputs and does not cause hypertrophy.
why.uz: Giyen–Mollare uchburchagi bir yo'nalishlidir: (1) Tishsimon yadro → SCP orqali ko'tarilib, kaudal o'rta miya kesishmasida (O1 plastinkasi) qarama-qarshi mayda hujayrali qizil yadroga o'tadi; (2) Qizil yadro → markaziy tegmental yo'l (CTT) bo'ylab ipsilateral pastki oliva yadrosiga (ION) tushadi; (3) ION → chirmashuvchi tolalarni o'rta chiziq orqali kesib o'tib, ICP orqali dastlabki tishsimon yadro/Purkine po'stlog'iga qaytaradi. Dastlabki ikki afferent bo'g'inning (tishsimon/SCP yoki qarama-qarshi CTT) uzilishi ION ni deafferentatsiyaga uchratib, bir necha oydan so'ng noyob trans-sinaptik vakuolyar oliva kattalashishi (T2 giperintensivligi) va ~2 Gs simptomatik okulopalatal tremorni chaqiradi. Uchinchi bo'g'inning (ICP) zararlanishi esa olivaga kiruvchi emas, undan chiquvchi efferent aksonlarni uzadi va gipertrofiya chaqirmaydi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: How do you clinically differentiate a classic superior cerebellar artery (SCA) infarct from a cerebellar-branch posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA) infarct, and what is the life-threatening complication of a large PICA stroke?
q.uz: Klinik jihatdan klassik ustki miyacha arteriyasi (SCA) infarktini orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasi (PICA) miyacha shoxi infarktidan qanday farqlaysiz va yirik PICA insultining hayotga xavf soluvchi asorati nima?

options.en: SCA: limb dysmetria/intention tremor and dysarthria with little vertigo; large PICA: severe vertigo/truncal ataxia and oedema causing hydrocephalus
options.uz: SCA: minimal bosh aylanishi bilan qo'l-oyoq dismetriyasi va dizartriya; yirik PICA: kuchli bosh aylanishi/tana ataksiyasi va 24–72 soatda o'tkir gidrosefaliya

options.en: SCA: severe vertigo, ipsilateral facial paralysis, and deafness with spared limb coordination; large PICA: isolated contralateral hemiparesis and bitemporal hemianopia
options.uz: SCA: kuchli bosh aylanishi, ipsilateral yuz falaji va karlik bilan qo'l koordinatsiyasi saqlanadi; yirik PICA: yakka kontralateral gemiparez va bitemporal gemianopiya

options.en: SCA: isolated truncal ataxia requiring urgent lumbar puncture decompression; large PICA: dentate nucleus necrosis causing delayed palatal tremor without hydrocephalus
options.uz: SCA: shoshilinch bel punksiyasi talab etuvchi yakka tana ataksiyasi; yirik PICA: gidrosefaliyasiz kechikkan tanglay tremorini chaqiruvchi tishsimon yadro nekrozi

options.en: SCA: acute severe vertigo and fourth-ventricle compression within 24 hours; large PICA: pure ipsilateral limb intention tremor with preserved stance and minimal oedema
options.uz: SCA: 24 soat ichida kuchli bosh aylanishi va IV qorincha ezilishi; yirik PICA: minimal shish va barqaror turish bilan sof ipsilateral qo'l-oyoq intension tremori

why.en: Because the SCA supplies the superior cerebellar hemisphere, the bulk of the dentate nucleus, the SCP, and the dorsolateral rostral pontine tegmentum (spinothalamic tract + descending sympathetic fibres), SCA strokes produce severe ipsilateral limb kinetic tremor/dysmetria and scanning dysarthria (plus ipsilateral Horner and contralateral body spinothalamic loss if the tegmental branch is occluded) with little vertigo. Conversely, PICA strokes hit the posteroinferior vermis/hemisphere (vestibulocerebellar connections), mimicking acute vestibular neuritis with explosive vertigo, nausea, and truncal ataxia; space-occupying cytotoxic oedema in the tight posterior fossa can efface the fourth ventricle (acute obstructive hydrocephalus) and cause tonsillar/upward herniation within 24–72 hours, requiring urgent suboccipital decompressive craniectomy.
why.uz: SCA miyacha ustki yarimsharini, tishsimon yadroning asosiy qismini, SCP ni va ko'prik rostral dorsolateral tegmentumini (spinotalamik yo'l + tushuvchi simpatik tolalar) ta'minlagani uchun, SCA insultlari bosh aylanishi deyarli bo'lmagan holda og'ir ipsilateral qo'l-oyoq kinetik tremori/dismetriyasi va skanerlovchi dizartriyani (tegmental shox berkilsa, ipsilateral Gorner va kontralateral tana og'riq/harorat yo'qolishi bilan birga) chaqiradi. Aksincha, PICA insultlari orqa-pastki chuvalchang/yarimsharni (vestibuloserebellyar aloqalar) zararlab, kuchli bosh aylanishi, ko'ngil aynishi va tana ataksiyasi bilan o'tkir vestibulyar nevritni eslatadi; tor orqa kalla chuqurchasidagi shish 24–72 soat ichida IV qorinchani ezib (o'tkir obstruktiv gidrosefaliya) va bodomchalar churrasini chaqirib, shoshilinch suboksipital dekompressiv kraniektomiyani talab qilishi mumkin.

q.en: What is the anatomical basis of (1) Cerebellar Cognitive Affective Syndrome (CCAS / Schmahmann syndrome) in adults and (2) Post-operative Cerebellar Mutism Syndrome in children after fourth-ventricle tumour resection?
q.uz: (1) Kattalardagi Miyacha kognitiv-affektiv sindromi (CCAS / Shmamann sindromi) hamda (2) bolalarda IV qorincha o'smasi olib tashlangandan keyingi Operatsiyadan keyingi miyacha mutizmi sindromining anatomik asosi nima?

options.en: CCAS: posterior lobe neocerebellar lesions (Crus I/II, VIIb) disrupting prefrontal loops; mutism: bilateral proximal dentate/SCP outflow injury
options.uz: CCAS: orqa bo'lak neoserebellyar (Crus I/II, VIIb) halqalari uzilishi; mutizm: proksimal tishsimon yadro/SCP chiqishining ikki tomonlama shikastlanishi

options.en: CCAS: isolated anterior lobe lesions (lobules I–IV) disrupting spinocerebellar loops; mutism: direct surgical retraction injury to Broca's area
options.uz: CCAS: oldingi bo'lak (I–IV bo'lakchalar) spinoserebellyar halqasi uzilishi; mutizm: operatsiya vaqtida Broka markazining bevosita shikastlanishi

options.en: CCAS: unilateral flocculonodular lobe (lobule X) lesions disrupting vestibular loops; mutism: isolated damage to the dorsal spinocerebellar tract
options.uz: CCAS: flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha) vestibulyar halqasi uzilishi; mutizm: dorsal spinoserebellyar yo'lning yakka shikastlanishi

options.en: CCAS: bilateral middle cerebellar peduncle degeneration sparing deep nuclei; mutism: unilateral fastigial and juxtarestiform body transection
options.uz: CCAS: chuqur yadrolar saqlangan holda ikki tomonlama MCP degeneratsiyasi; mutizm: cho'qqi yadrosi va yukstarestiform tananing bir tomonlama kesilishi

why.en: Posterior lobe hemispheric areas (especially Crus I, Crus II, and VIIb) form closed-loop circuits via the ventral/caudal dentate nucleus and thalamus with prefrontal, posterior parietal, and superior temporal cortices; lesions there produce CCAS (executive dysfunction, visuospatial deficits, agrammatism/prosodic changes, and affective blunting or disinhibition) often without severe motor ataxia. In children after midline posterior-fossa tumour resection, bilateral disruption of the dentate nuclei and/or superior cerebellar peduncles (dentato-rubro-thalamo-cortical tract) causes cerebello-cerebral diaschisis and the posterior fossa syndrome (delayed-onset transient mutism evolving into dysarthria, emotional lability, hypotonia, and ataxia).
why.uz: Orqa bo'lak yarimshar sohalari (ayniqsa Crus I, Crus II va VIIb) tishsimon yadroning ventral/kaudal qismi va talamus orqali prefrontal, orqa parietal hamda ustki chakka po'stlog'i bilan yopiq halqalar hosil qiladi; bu joyning zararlanishi og'ir motor ataksiyasiz ham CCAS (ijrochi disfunksiya, fazoviy-ko'ruv buzilishlari, agrammatizm/prosodiya o'zgarishi va emotsional to'mtoqlashuv yoki tormozlanishning yo'qolishi) chaqiradi. Bolalarda o'rta chiziq orqa kalla chuqurchasi o'smasi olib tashlangach, tishsimon yadrolar va/yoki ustki miyacha oyoqchalarining (dentato-rubro-talamo-kortikal yo'l) ikki tomonlama shikastlanishi serebello-serebral diasxiz va orqa kalla chuqurchasi sindromini (1–2 kundan so'ng boshlanib, dizartriyaga o'tuvchi vaqtinchalik mutizm, emotsional labillik, gipotoniya va ataksiya) yuzaga keltiradi.

q.en: A 58-year-old patient presents with progressive gait and limb ataxia, orthostatic hypotension, and urinary retention. Axial T2 MRI of the pons shows a cruciform hyperintensity ('hot-cross-bun sign') with middle cerebellar peduncle atrophy. Degeneration of which tracts produces this MRI sign?
q.uz: 58 yoshli bemorda kuchayib boruvchi yurish va qo'l-oyoq ataksiyasi, ortostatik gipotenziya hamda siydik tutilishi bor. Ko'prikning aksial T2 MRT tasvirida o'rta miyacha oyoqchalari atrofiyasi bilan birga xochsimon giperintensivlik ('hot-cross-bun' belgisi) ko'rinadi. Qaysi yo'llarning degeneratsiyasi ushbu belgini hosil qiladi?

options.en: Transverse pontocerebellar fibres and median pontine raphe, sparing corticospinal bundles (MSA-C)
options.uz: Ko'ndalang pontoserebellyar tolalar va ko'prik o'rta choki (raphe), kortikospinal tutamlar saqlangan (MSA-C)

options.en: Superior cerebellar peduncle decussation and central tegmental tracts in the dorsal midbrain tegmentum
options.uz: Dorsal o'rta miya tegmentumidagi ustki miyacha oyoqchasi kesishmasi va markaziy tegmental yo'llar

options.en: Bilateral inferior olivary nuclei and olivocerebellar climbing fibres in the rostral ventral medulla
options.uz: Rostral ventral uzunchoq miyadagi ikki tomonlama pastki oliva yadrolari va olivoserebellyar tolalar

options.en: Descending corticospinal and corticobulbar tracts in the basis pontis, sparing transverse pontine fibres
options.uz: Ko'ndalang ko'prik tolalari saqlangan holda ko'prik asosidagi tushuvchi kortikospinal va kortikobulbar yo'llar

why.en: In multiple system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C, olivopontocerebellar atrophy), loss of basilar pontine neurons and their myelinated transverse pontocerebellar fibres (entering the middle cerebellar peduncles, MCP) along with median pontine raphe fibres produces a horizontal + vertical T2-hyperintense cross in the basis pontis ('hot-cross-bun sign'), while the four quadrants containing the descending corticospinal tracts (and the dorsally placed SCPs) remain comparatively dark and preserved.
why.uz: Multi-tizimli atrofiyaning miyacha shaklida (MSA-C, olivopontoserebellyar atrofiya) bazilyar ko'prik neyronlari va ularning o'rta miyacha oyoqchalariga (MCP) kiruvchi miyelinlashgan ko'ndalang pontoserebellyar tolalari hamda ko'prik o'rta choki (raphe) ning yo'qolishi ko'prik asosida gorizontal va vertikal T2-giperintensiv xoch ('hot-cross-bun' belgisi) hosil qiladi; tushuvchi kortikospinal yo'llarni (hamda dorsal joylashgan SCP larni) o'z ichiga olgan to'rtta kvadrant esa nisbatan to'q va saqlangan qoladi.
